lines.en: Belly to the sand, I creep forward.
My claws dig into the earth.
I go a step, stop, and look around.

lines.zh: 我的身体还小，藏在草里
lines.en: I'm small enough to hide in the grass.

lines.zh: 测试用的龙，从石缝里挤。
lines.en: A test dragon squeezes through the crack.
I crawl toward that patch of light.
I go slowly, body low.
My tail sweeps the sand.
I circle the edge of the nest.
I lift my head on a long neck.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在沙里划一道。
lines.en: My tail draws a line in the sand.
Then I back off half a step.
I crouch by the nest without moving.
My scales haven't hardened yet.

lines.zh: 我在听这座遗迹的响声
lines.en: I listen to the sounds of this ruin.

lines.zh: 风从石缝里过，发出声音
lines.en: Wind passes the cracks and makes sound.
I am only a test dragon.
The sand here is very fine.
My tail tip taps the ground.

lines.zh: 我记得蛋壳裂开的声音
lines.en: I remember the sound of the shell cracking.

lines.zh: 我不过是这遗迹里的一个
lines.en: I'm only one thing in this ruin.
My tail tip taps the ground.

lines.zh: 巢边的沙被风吹得变了形
lines.en: Wind reshapes the sand by the nest.

lines.zh: 我把爪子收进身体下面
lines.en: I tuck my claws under my body.
I tilt my head and listen to the echo.

lines.zh: 这里除了我，没有别的活物
lines.en: Apart from me, nothing living is here.
You stand taller than I.
I keep the smell of you.
My eyes brighten slowly.

lines.zh: 我不确定你是不是敌人
lines.en: I'm not sure whether you're an enemy.
I open my mouth. No teeth yet.
My teeth haven't grown yet.
Don't reach your hand over here.
I've waited many days here.
I have a name, yet none call it.

lines.zh: 我只是一个测试用的名字。
lines.en: I'm only a test name here.
If you move, go slowly.
I'll watch first, without moving.
There's warmth about you.
I don't readily trust strangers.
But there's no one else in this ruin.
I can only keep watching you.
Stay if you wish.
You stop; I stop where I am.
I retreat a long way.
A scale has split.
I shrink to the nest's edge.
Blood drips onto the sand.
I open my mouth and no sound comes.
My claws close on nothing.
Head down, guarding my neck.
I'm small. I can't take much.
I scrape at the sand.
I shrink into a crevice and lick the wound.
That smell is new to me.
I stretch my neck and sniff.
I'm not a good judge.
I sniff first, then lick.
Leave it and I'll try it slowly.
Odd taste, but all right.
Even a test entity has teeth.
I can't bite through this yet.
Too little; it's gone in one bite.
I've moved away.
I roll away and hit a rock.
Knocked over, I roll back onto my feet.
You're far bigger than I.
I hide in a crevice, eyes showing.
I brush your boot and keep going.
A little powder comes off my scales.
I lower my head, but don't submit.
Then I face you again.
A layer of dust scrapes off my scales.
Don't tread on me.
I'm the only one in this ruin.
I don't understand what you're saying.
Others of my kind are far away.
I turn my head toward the nest.
There were other eggs here once.
Now only broken shell remains.
These eggs aren't mine.
But you may stand there.
Just don't come too close.
I haven't grown up yet.
I pick up a shard of bone.
I'll keep this.

lines.zh: 我拽了两下，它纹丝不动。
lines.en: I tug twice; it doesn't budge.

lines.zh: 我用后爪刨坑，把它埋了。
lines.en: I dig with my hind claws and bury it.
Two bites, and I can't crack it.
This looks somewhat useful.
I pile it by the nest.
You dropped it? Let me look.
Too small for me to hold.
I pick it up, then spit it out.
Footsteps are coming near.
I raise my head that way.

lines.zh: 这不是沙子落下的声音
lines.en: That isn't sand falling.
Sand covers my back.
My eyes fix on that dark corner.
I circle downwind before closing in.
The test mouth opens.
My heartbeat quickens.
I press against the stone and hold my breath.

lines.zh: 我伏低身子，一寸寸靠近。
lines.en: I keep low and close in inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我的爪子已经扣住地面。
lines.en: My claws have dug into the ground.
Now.
I lunge out.
Sand sprays up.
It fell back.
I don't chase that far.
I track it as it moves.
I circle to the far side of the stone.

lines.zh: 我的身子太低，看不见我
lines.en: I'm too low to be seen.
It's looking for a way out.
I stand between you and the door.
I've blocked that path.
I creep forward.
It's backing away.
One more step and it's in front of me.
I dig my claws into the sand.

lines.zh: 我仰起头，盯着你的喉咙。
lines.en: I raise my head and fix on your throat.
It has turned.
From this moment on.
I don't retreat again.
You're inside my reach.
I spring.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在你脚边刨土。
lines.en: My claws scrape dirt at your feet.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，我就近一分。
lines.en: Every step you take, I get closer.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的护腿，甩了甩头。
lines.en: I bite your legging and shake my head.
My teeth are small but sharp.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，爪子勾住你的衣摆。
lines.en: I lunge and hook my claws in your hem.
My claws miss; I nearly fall.
It throws me off.
I land and roll.
I lunge again.
I catch the edge of its clothes.
I tear once.
I stop where I am, panting.
I stand panting on the sand.
My claws are still trembling.
I return to the nest.
This is still mine.
I step back half a pace.
So did it.
I struggle out of the egg.
Bits of shell cling to my back.
This is a very old ruin.
Broken shell lies everywhere.
I try to stand.
My legs are soft; I'm unsteady.
There's warm wind by the light; I go.
My first breath — the air is dry.
I hear wind through the cracks.
I look back once at the shell.
Then I walk on.
Quiet enough to hear the stone tick.
I mark this path.
I begin to crawl out.
Sand runs between my claws.
It's far brighter than the egg.

lines.zh: 石头后面，我的眼睛先亮。
lines.en: Behind the rock, my eyes light first.

lines.zh: 我朝着有声音的方向去
lines.en: I head toward the sound.
A lick of fire rolls me over.
I fall off the stone ledge.
Water chokes me; I paddle hard.
The blast throws me against the wall.
Even a test entity feels this.
A flash leaves me unable to move.
Too long hungry; I can't stand.
In the lightning I go rigid.
The sand is gone, and I fall.
